name: Jackal's Hunt Multiplayer PvE Mission
summary: Persistent multiplayer PvE mission on the Syria map built with DML, MOOSE, EWRS and SPGG.
description: Multiplayer PvE `.miz` for the Syria map with many flyable aircraft, including the F-4E. It needs the Hercules and community A-4E-C mods. Persistence needs `MissionScripting.lua` edited in the DCS install folder (io/lfs desanitised).
